description: TPL Trakker Limited is a Pakistani telematics and IoT service provider, part of the TPL Group. It holds the vehicle-tracking licence first granted in 1999 and has been operating for more than two decades, selling vehicle, personal and asset tracking, fleet management, and IoT systems for fuel, video surveillance, cold chain, water level, smart farming and waste management. It also operates in the UAE, and is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
